description: This file defines the 'Rule' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically handling autofilter rules for worksheet columns. It manages filter types, operators, and groupings used in spreadsheet autofilter functionality.

classes.name: Rule
classes.description: Represents an autofilter rule associated with a worksheet column, providing methods to set and validate filter types, values, operators, and groupings.

methods.name: getRuleType
methods.description: Returns the type of the autofilter rule, such as filter, date group, or custom filter.

methods.name: setRuleType
methods.description: Sets the rule type after validating it against allowed types.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with the filter rule, which can be a single value or an array for date groups.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the filter value, performing validation and determining date grouping if an array is provided.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator used for the filter, such as equals, greater than, etc.

methods.name: setOperator
methods.description: Sets the filter operator after validation against allowed operators.

methods.name: getGrouping
methods.description: Returns the grouping type for date or dynamic filters.

methods.name: setGrouping
methods.description: Sets the grouping type, validating against allowed groupings.

methods.name: setRule
methods.description: Convenience method to set operator, value, and optional grouping together.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent autofilter column associated with this rule.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Associates a parent autofilter column with this rule.
